subject: Security portal field governance for Vendr profile
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@vendr.com>, security@vendr.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security portal field governance for Vendr profile

Hi Priya / Vendr security team —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We’re starting a short project to canonicalize Vendr profile fields against our SIG/CAIQ view so that our SOC 2 evidence automation works reliably across portals. Outline of what we need from Vendr: 

- A canonical field mapping (Vendr field name -> Redwood canonical name) for the profile schema (SIG/CAIQ overlap fields first). I’ve sketched a first pass in the attached vendr_field_mapping.csv.
- Guidance on de-duplicating fields (e.g., multiple "contact.email" variants) and a recommended primary key for profile merges.
- Export options: API token or CSV export of the current account profile dump (we’ll use it to validate mapping).
- Evidence attachments: best format for programmatic upload (we prefer presigned S3 + metadata keys) and any max file-size limits.

Timeline: can you confirm feasibility for a 10 business day turnaround for a mapping + sample export? If Vendr needs more time, propose a short phased plan (mapping first, export second).

Attached: vendr_field_mapping.csv (our draft), current_whistic_export.json (for reference).

If helpful I can schedule a 30 min mapping workshop with your security/product engineer — please share availability.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Manager, Security & Integrations
Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0163

---
Attachments: vendr_field_mapping.csv (CSV, 8KB), current_whistic_export.json (JSON, 120KB)

From: Priya Shah <priya@vendr.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security portal field governance for Vendr profile

Hi Camila —

Thanks — this is great context. Happy to help; we can support both a CSV export and an API token for the account export. Quick answers up front: 

- Export: we can provide a one-time CSV export and create a read-only API token scoped to profile exports. API token preferred for automation.
- Field mapping: we’ll run your CSV (vendr_field_mapping.csv) against our canonical schema and return a proposed mapping spreadsheet. We’ll flag fields that are ambiguous or duplicated.
- Evidence upload: Vendr supports presigned PUT for files up to 50MB and accepts a metadata JSON blob per attachment.

Questions for you: 
1) Is SOC 2 the only compliance scope for this mapping, or should we include CAIQ-derived questions now?
2) Do you want us to map ALL Vendr profile fields or just those that map to SIG/CAIQ first?

Proposed timeline: 
- Day 0–2: Confirm scope & access (we need a Vendr Admin invite to the account alias redwood-vendr@vendr.com or an API token request form).
- Day 3–6: Internal mapping pass (we’ll return a marked-up spreadsheet).
- Day 7–10: Share export + mapping validation workshop.

I’ll attach a small sample export (vendr_export_sample.csv) so you can sanity-check our CSV formatting. If that looks good we’ll proceed with API token provisioning.

Thanks Priya — that timeline looks reasonable. Answers inline: 

- Scope: Please include CAIQ-derived fields in the mapping (we want the mapping to cover SIG, CAIQ v3.1, and our SOC 2 evidence labels).
- Target fields: Start with SIG/CAIQ overlap + the 20 high-value fields we listed in the CSV; we’ll expand after the first pass.
- Access: API token is preferred. I’ve created a minimal request doc and permissions checklist in the Drive link below (redwood-vendr/onboarding-mapping). We can create a short-lived token for the mapping phase.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood-vendr/onboarding-mapping
HubSpot: hubspot.com/contacts/HS-004821 (HubSpot ID HS-004821)

I’ll also attach a short note for your ops team describing the exact metadata JSON we’ll send alongside evidence (redwood_vendr_permissions.md).

Can we schedule the mapping workshop on Monday 24th or Tuesday 25th? I’m proposing 11:00–11:30 PT; Kimberly and Marissa will join for the workshop.

Thanks — Camila
